answer: The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in mirror, expire in nebula, and copper lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 96 aliases therefore needs 175 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4488 identities would post 4367 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
